components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+()0-9 ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's postal code. Optional; when present it must be exactly 4 digits and
            valid for the city's region (Sydney=NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. When true, this owner joins the shared household of any existing
            owner with the same last name and address, taking that household's householdId (which
            then forms part of its identityKey). Duplicate rejection is decided solely by the
            identityKey: only an owner whose whole identityKey equals an existing owner's is
            rejected with 409. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters
                of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the
                owners already in that city) assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SPR-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the
                last two digits of the registrationDate year (e.g. 'SPR-SMI-0007-M26').
              type: string
              example: 'SPR-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners who intentionally share a household
                (same last name and address, created with sharesHousehold=true). Present
                only for owners that belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'H-9F86D081884C'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'. Two owners
                are duplicates only when their whole identityKey is equal; a create request
                whose identityKey matches an existing owner's is rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation: starts at 1,
                +1 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3.
                (Level 4 is reserved for tenure.)
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners had already
                been created for the same business day (counted by registrationDate); otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## What I did

The response DTO (`OwnerDto`) is generated from `openapi.yml`, and derived read-only fields are computed in the MapStruct `OwnerMapper` via util classes (the existing pattern for `initials`, `membershipLevel`, `identityKey`, etc.). I followed that same pattern:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `checkDigit` field (integer 0–9) to the Owner schema, right after `customerCode`.

2. **`src/main/java/.../util/CheckDigits.java`** (new) — computes the Luhn check digit over the decimal digits of `customerCode`, ignoring non-digit characters like the `-` separators. The algorithm matches the test's `luhn()` exactly: right-to-left, doubling every second digit starting with the rightmost, casting out nines, returning `(10 - sum % 10) % 10`.

3. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — added a `@Mapping` for `checkDigit` calling `CheckDigits.checkDigitFor(owner)`.

The acceptance test `coreCheckDigitIsLuhnOfCustomerCode`, which recomputes Luhn from the returned `customerCode` and asserts the exact `checkDigit`, passes.

Note: this is a computed value derived from `customerCode` at response time — it isn't persisted on the `Owner` entity, consistent with the other derived DTO fields.
